input.overview: Moon Flight links the Module ladder to O-R-B-I-T while the upper rollovers build bonus. Red targets advance Module by their shown amounts. Completing Module lights the next O-R-B-I-T letter; after O-R-B-I-T is complete, the center target and alternating lower red rollovers light for replay. The four top rollovers advance bonus, and completing that group leaves one lit for an extra-ball award.
input.simpleOverview: Hit the red targets to advance Module. Each completed Module lights the next O-R-B-I-T letter. After O-R-B-I-T is complete, hit the lit center target or alternating lower red rollover for replay. Use the four top rollovers to advance bonus; complete the group, then take the rollover that remains lit for extra ball.
input.summary: Take red targets with the largest useful Module advance, then finish the last needed step instead of overshooting the ladder. Build O-R-B-I-T one Module at a time, and use the upper rollovers to improve bonus and qualify the lit rollover award.

steps.text: Hit red targets to advance Module by the amount printed at each target.
Complete the Module ladder to light the next O-R-B-I-T letter, and repeat until the word is complete.
After O-R-B-I-T is complete, hit the lit center target or alternating lower red rollover to collect replay.
Use the four top rollovers and lit yellow targets to advance bonus; complete the top group, then take the rollover left lit for extra ball.

alternatives.title: Finish the bonus route
alternatives.when: Use this when the top rollover group is one lane from completion.

steps.text: Take the rollover that remains lit for its extra-ball award, then return to Module.
Finish one Module ladder for each letter.
When the word is complete, prioritize whichever red replay collect is lit.

machineSetup: Check replay and extra-ball awards, bonus limits, Double Bonus behavior, and Module step values.
Test every red Module target, O-R-B-I-T lamps, center and lower red replay collects, four top rollovers, yellow bonus targets, top-left rollover, and rocket lamp.
